title: Organic traffic down since AI overviews, what are B2B folks doing?

comments.text: Down 40% year on year for informational terms. The bottom-of-funnel stuff held up but that's a small slice.
We stopped reporting traffic to the board entirely. Now it's demo requests and where they say they heard of us.
Founder here, 12 person dev shop. I keep asking our marketing person 'does Google AI mention us' and she doesn't know how to check.
The ones who are fine are the ones who were already the obvious answer in their niche. Everyone else is scrambling.
